def find_beautiful_sequence(k, q):
    n = len(q)
    if n % k != 0:
        return "NO"
    
    segment_length = n // k
    used_chars = set()
    result = []
    
    for i in range(k):
        start = i * segment_length
        end = start + segment_length
        segment = q[start:end]
        
        # Ensure all characters in the segment are unique
        if len(segment) == len(set(segment)):
            result.append(segment)
            used_chars.update(segment)
        else:
            return "NO"
    
    # Ensure all first characters are distinct
    if len(used_chars) != k:
        return "NO"
    
    return "YES\n" + "\n".join(result)

        return "NO"

    current_group = q[0]
    for char in q[1:]:
        if char == current_group[-1]:
            current_group += char
        else:
            groups.append(current_group)
            current_group = char
    groups.append(current_group)
    
    # If the number of groups is less than k, we cannot form a beautiful sequence
    if len(groups) < k:
        return "NO"
    
    # Assign each group to a separate string in the sequence
    beautiful_sequence = groups[:k]
    
    return "YES\n" + "\n".join(beautiful_sequence)
